title: Footprints, wet ground and glowing spells
text:
Footprints, a hover glow, projectile trails and impact flashes, wet ground after rain, mount dust and class idle animations.

✨ Footprints: heroes leave prints in snow, sand and ash that slowly fade away
✨ The monster under your mouse now glows softly, so you always know what you are about to click
✨ Spell projectiles now leave a sparkling trail, light up the ground as they fly, and flash with light where they hit
✨ Rain leaves the ground wet: darker earth, a shiny sheen and puddles that mirror the sky. It slowly dries after the rain stops (not in the snow, the Caldera or the Vault)
✨ Mounts kick up dust on dirt roads and grass, sand in the dunes, snow in Frostpeak and spray in shallow water
✨ Idle animations by class: Bulwarks roll their shoulders, Barbarians take deep breaths, Assassins crouch and watch, Bards sway to a tune, Hunters scan the horizon and casters drift slightly off the ground
